Description.Name: Kel Snowborn
Description.Details: Kel Snowborn, aka "Gunrunner", is an ex-bounty hunter from the mercenary group DDI. After a shady deal went bad, he was forced into hiding and left the spacer life. Three years later Kel re-emerged as a MechWarrior, running a small mercenary operation. Aggressive and intelligent, Kel seems to have a gift in his ability to adapt quickly to any tactical situation, and he is a dangerous asset to any lance.
